published_setting: Female C57BL/6J mice; anti-PD-1 with or without MCC950
reported_timing: Fig.2 cardiac experiment: B16F10 inoculation on day 0; indicated treatments every other day on days 7-19; hearts collected on day 20. Fig.3 tumor readouts include volume on day 19 and weight on day 20.
comparison_arms_by_endpoint: Fig.2 cardiac: IgG+vehicle; anti-PD-1+vehicle; anti-PD-1+MCC950. Fig.3 tumor: these treatment categories plus IgG+MCC950.
actual_endpoints: Fig.2: plasma cTnT, echocardiography, cardiac CD8/F4/80 infiltration, TUNEL, fibrosis and inflammatory transcripts. Fig.3: tumor volume/weight and tumor immune-cell phenotypes.
reported_finding: MCC950 mitigated cardiac injury during anti-PD-1 treatment (Fig.2); combination with anti-PD-1 reduced tumor burden under the tested B16F10 conditions (Fig.3).
model_selection_use: A published coadministration context with both cardiac and tumor readouts under single-ICI treatment.
unresolved_or_not_supported: The additional IgG+MCC950 arm belongs to the Fig.3 tumor comparison, not the Fig.2 cardiac comparison. Assays are not assumed to use identical individual mice.
source_locator: Methods: Mice and cell lines (s2-1), Animal grouping and treatment (s2-2); Results s3-2/Fig.2 caption (F2); Results s3-3/Fig.3 caption (F3).

published_setting: Female C57BL/6J mice; anti-PD-1 plus anti-CTLA-4 with or without MCC950
reported_timing: Fig.6: B16F10 inoculation on day 0; indicated treatments every other day on days 7-19; hearts collected on day 20. Tumor volume is reported on day 19 and tumor weight on day 20.
actual_endpoints: Plasma cTnT, echocardiography, cardiac immune infiltration, apoptosis, fibrosis and inflammatory transcripts; tumor volume and weight.
reported_finding: MCC950 mitigated cardiac phenotypes during dual anti-PD-1 plus anti-CTLA-4 therapy and was associated with reduced tumor burden in the tested B16F10 model (Fig.6).
model_selection_use: A published dual-ICI coadministration context for considering cardiac and tumor readouts together.
unresolved_or_not_supported: The reported schedule and comparator set belong to the B16F10 coadministration experiment; the established-injury experiment is a separate setting.
source_locator: Methods s2-1/s2-2; Results s3-6; Fig.6 caption (F6).

published_setting: Mouse anti-PD-1 protocol with MCC950 evaluated after cardiac injury was established
reported_timing: Results s3-7 reports five anti-PD-1 doses before the MCC950 treatment phase. The main text's later dosing phrase is unclear; exact days and whether anti-PD-1 continued are not specified here.
comparison_arms_by_endpoint: The main text describes MCC950 treatment in established anti-PD-1 cardiac injury but does not enumerate the complete comparator/control arm list. Supplementary Fig.7 is referenced; its full protocol was not inspected for this resource.
actual_endpoints: Reported echocardiographic impairment: reduced ejection capacity and ventricular dilation, with amelioration after MCC950. No tumor readout is established for this protocol.
reported_finding: MCC950 evaluated after established anti-PD-1 cardiac injury ameliorated the reported echocardiographic impairment (Results s3-7).
model_selection_use: A published precedent for a cardiac-function question after established ICI injury without a tumor-bearing context.
unresolved_or_not_supported: Exact calendar, subsequent ICI schedule, complete comparator/control arms and group n remain unverified. Do not import Fig.2/Fig.6 details or infer antitumor preservation in this setting.
source_locator: Results s3-7: NLRP3 inhibition attenuates established ICI-induced cardiotoxicity; main-text description pointing to Supplementary Fig.7A-B (SP2).
